chapter: Gillespie and Carter on John Collins
title: Carter on recording with Collins: Definitions, Further Definitions and Thirty by Ella
summary: Carter and Willard work out dates of their records together, including the five-saxophone album, and Carter will give her copies.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: We've recorded together, you know, on several occasions. He was on my last album.
Yeah, he mentioned that. He said he thought it was 1964, but I talked to an enthusiastic record collector the other night and he said, 'Oh no, that was 1961'.
Oh no, no, no, that was about '65, you see, because I know that "Definitions" was what -- 1962.
Oh I'm sorry, I thought that was the one you were referring to.
Then later we did "Addition to Further Definitions", which we did here.
Oh.
That was probably 1965. John would remember that though.
He remembers the session but he doesn't remember the year.
How about that. I'm not absolutely sure, honestly, but it was -- it had to be around then.
John thought there were five saxaphones. I don't have the record.
That's right, that's right, see
because the other one had only four saxophones.
Yeah, on the first one he was trying to think of a fifth saxophone.
Oh, he was on the first one too, that's right.
Yes.
In New York.
Yes. He said, 'They think "Super Sax" is such a big deal', he said, 'Benny did that on that album with Coleman Hawkins'.
Oh, well I didn't do much on that but he did do that. That's right. You don't have those albums, do you?
I don't have them, no.
I have them for you if you want them.
Oh, I'd love to have them.
Oh sure. Both of them I have for you.
Wonderful, wonderful, and then do you remember the times he recorded with you before in New York, --
No, I don't.
-- way back, because he says he knows he recorded with you but he can't remember what or when or whom?
I can't either, but he did that album with me with Ella Fitzgerald, 'Thirty by Ella'. I don't even
remember what year that was. It hasn't been too long.
Yeah, he mentioned that one.
Three or four years at Capitol.
Um hmmm.
